title: polygala amara subsp. alpestris
intro: Polygala amara subsp. alpestris, commonly known as Alpine Milkwort, is a rare and lesser-known subspecies of the Polygala amara plant, which belongs to the family Polygalaceae. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, particularly in the treatment of respiratory and cardiovascular issues. The health benefits of Polygala amara subsp. alpestris include its potential to alleviate symptoms of bronchitis, asthma, and coughs, as well as its ability to lower blood pressure and improve circulation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and vasodilatory effects.
